briefdescription.para: This function validates the USER eFUSE key provisioning parameters.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ProvisionUserEfuseParams structure which holds the USER eFUSE key provisioning input arguments.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the parameters are validated successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if the parameters validation fails.

inbodydescription.para: Validate the target eFUSE key identifier.
Validate the key length (only 256-bit keys are supported by USER eFUSE keys).
USER_EFUSE_KEY_0 is the ASU KEK seed and is black only. USER_EFUSE_KEY_1 may be black or red.
Validate the key source, its corresponding KeyId/KeyAddr fields, and the key source against the destination eFUSE.
ASU generates the key; no KeyId/KeyAddr must be supplied.
Vault source: rejected for eFUSE0; KeyId non-zero, KeyAddr zero.
Buffer source: rejected for eFUSE0; KeyAddr non-zero, KeyId zero.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the parameters are validated successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if the parameters validation fails.

inbodydescription.para: Validate the certificate output buffer address and its actual-size output address.
Validate the certificate output buffer size.
TODO: Accept SLH-DSA after the UDE API, OCP key generation/encryption and DPC format support an SLH-DSA key type.
Validate the UDE key type (only ECC NIST P-384 is supported currently).
Validate the target UDE eFUSE slot.

briefdescription.para: Read a 32-bit little-endian value from an unaligned byte buffer.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to at least four input bytes.

briefdescription.para: Write a 16-bit value to an unaligned byte buffer in little-endian order.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to at least two output bytes.

briefdescription.para: Write a 32-bit value to an unaligned byte buffer in little-endian order.

briefdescription.para: Validate that a vault ID explicitly selects a user-owned vault.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if VaultId selects a user-owned vault.
XST_FAILURE, if VaultId requests auto-assignment, an ASU-owned vault or an out-of-range vault.

briefdescription.para: Validate that a composite key ID explicitly selects a slot in a user-owned vault.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if KeyId selects a non-zero slot in a user-owned vault.
XST_FAILURE, if KeyId requests slot auto-assignment or selects a reserved or out-of-range vault.

briefdescription.para: This function computes the AEPI image size required for a provisioning-instruction stream.

parameterdescription.para: Size of the plaintext instruction-record stream in bytes.
Pointer that receives the required image size in bytes.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the image size is returned successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if RecordBlobLen is outside the supported range or ImageSizePtr is NULL.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the atomic AEPI wrap-command parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the parameters are valid and the output buffer is large enough.
XST_FAILURE, if a mandatory address is zero, the record length is unsupported or the output buffer is too small.

briefdescription.para: Validate the atomic AEPI unwrap-command parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the parameters identify a complete AEPI image buffer.
XST_FAILURE, if the pointer or image address is NULL, the image is shorter than its fixed header, its address range overflows, or a reserved field is non-zero.

briefdescription.para: Validate CREATE_KEY_VAULT parameters used by an AEPI record.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the key-vault creation parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the request explicitly selects a valid user vault and its key-manager creation parameters are valid.
XST_FAILURE, if any parameter is invalid or requests output-ID auto-assignment.

briefdescription.para: Validate STORE_KEY metadata used by an AEPI record and resolve its wire-data length.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer that receives the serialized key-object length.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if the metadata is valid for an unwrapped key in an explicit user slot.
XST_FAILURE, if a pointer, key ID, key type, metadata field, attribute, use case or serialized key-object length is invalid.

inbodydescription.para: Validate the metadata fields for the selected key type.

briefdescription.para: Validate XOR-key parameters used by an AEPI record.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if all three key IDs select explicit user slots and the key-manager XOR parameters are valid.
XST_FAILURE, if any parameter is invalid or requests output-ID auto-assignment.
